# 2027. Minimum Moves to Convert String

## Solution 1 (time O(n), space O(1))

```python
class Solution(object):
    def minimumMoves(self, s):
        """
        :type s: str
        :rtype: int
        """
        ans = 0
        n = len(s)
        p = 0
        while p < len(s):
            if s[p] != "O":
                ans += 1
                p += 3
            else:
                p += 1
        return ans
```
